pictures.name: CSM1-Temple-Steps
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The great stone steps and colonnades of the Temple in Jerusalem, first century, bright morning, crowds of pilgrims, priests in white, sellers of doves. In the middle, Mary, a young woman with dark hair under a soft blue veil, carries a newborn baby wrapped snugly in plain cream cloth, turned away from the viewer, his face hidden in the folds of the cloth and never visible, a soft glow of light around him, wrapped in her arms, beside Joseph, a man of about thirty with a short dark beard, in a brown tunic, holding a small wicker cage with two turtledoves, both small and humble among the crowd climbing the steps. Gold sunlight on the pale stone, deep blue shadows under the porticoes. Humility, ordinariness, quiet hope. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CSM2-Simeon-Waits
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A quiet corner of a stone house in Jerusalem at dawn. In the middle, Simeon, a very old man with a long white beard and bright tearful eyes, in a cream prayer shawl with blue stripes, sits by a small window with folded hands, looking out toward the distant Temple roofs, patient and expectant. A worn walking staff leans by him, a lamp burned low. Pale gold light rising, deep blue shadows. Long patient waiting, hope. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CSM3-Simeon-Holds
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The sunlit Temple court in Jerusalem, crowds passing. In the middle, Simeon, a very old man with a long white beard and bright tearful eyes, in a cream prayer shawl with blue stripes, holds a newborn baby wrapped snugly in plain cream cloth, turned away from the viewer, his face hidden in the folds of the cloth and never visible, a soft glow of light around him, in his arms, lifting his face to heaven with tears of joy, mouth open in prayer. Mary, a young woman with dark hair under a soft blue veil, and Joseph, a man of about thirty with a short dark beard, in a brown tunic, holding a small wicker cage with two turtledoves, stand close, amazed. Passers-by blur around them unaware. A shaft of gold light falls on Simeon and the child, deep blue shadows under the colonnade. Fulfilment, joy, peace. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CSM4-Light-Nations
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Close view in the Temple court: Simeon, a very old man with a long white beard and bright tearful eyes, in a cream prayer shawl with blue stripes, still holding the swaddled baby, the baby turned away and his face hidden in the cloth, turns his face toward Mary, a young woman with dark hair under a soft blue veil, speaking gently, his free hand resting on her shoulder; Mary listens, her face full of tenderness and a shadow of sorrow. A warm golden light seems to glow from the bundled child, whose face is never visible, deep blue shadows behind. The three in the middle. Tenderness, prophecy, light. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CSM5-Anna-Prays
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The Temple court near a pillar, lamplight and morning light mixing. In the middle, Anna, a very old woman, small and bright-eyed, in a dark plum veil and a simple grey robe, comes forward with her hands raised in thanks, face shining with joy, speaking to a small gathered group of ordinary men and women who listen with wonder; behind her, Mary, a young woman with dark hair under a soft blue veil, holds the swaddled baby turned against her shoulder, his face hidden and never visible, and Simeon, a very old man with a long white beard and bright tearful eyes, in a cream prayer shawl with blue stripes, watches smiling. Gold light, deep blue shadows. Joy, faithfulness rewarded. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CSM6-Today-Candlemas
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A modern Catholic church on the evening of February 2, painted in the same sacred oil style: a procession of ordinary people of all ages walks up the aisle carrying lit white candles, a priest in white vestments ahead blessing them with holy water; an elderly man with a cane and his teenage granddaughter walk side by side, both holding candles, both smiling. Warm gold candlelight filling the dim nave, deep blue shadows. The procession in the middle. Light, hope, community. No text, no letters, no logos.
